<thought>From the ¹H NMR spectrum we see six distinct signals (at 1.43, 2.69, 5.05, 7.13, 7.39, and 7.90 ppm). Each signal corresponds to a unique hydrogen environment, regardless of how many protons contribute to it. Therefore, the compound has six chemically equivalent hydrogen types.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
